components.name: Relentless Endurance

components.name: Second Wind
components.description: Regain 1d10 + Fighter level hit points; one use per short or long rest.

components.name: Action Surge
components.description: Take one additional action on your turn. Two uses at Fighter 17; at most one use on a turn. The caller tracks the additional action and per-turn limit.

components.name: Indomitable
components.description: Reroll a failed saving throw and use the new result.

components.text: Add this bonus only to attacks with ranged weapons.

Reroll a 1 or 2 on a damage die of a melee attack with a two-handed or versatile weapon wielded in two hands; use the new result.

components.name: Protect ally

components.text: Add your ability modifier to the damage of the second attack made using two-weapon fighting.
Apply half proficiency rounded up to other untrained Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution checks. Increase running long jump distance by Strength modifier.

components.name: Survivor
components.description: At the start of your turn, regain 5 + Constitution modifier HP when above 0 HP and no more than half maximum HP.

components.text: Once per turn, add sneakAttackDice d6 to a finesse or ranged weapon hit with advantage, or with another non-incapacitated enemy of the target within 5 feet and no disadvantage.
Understand and convey secret messages through coded conversation, symbols, and signs.

components.name: Fast Hands
components.description: Use Cunning Action to make a Sleight of Hand check, use thieves’ tools to disarm a trap or open a lock, or take the Use an Object action.

components.text: Second-Story Work: climbing costs no extra movement; running jump distance increases by Dexterity modifier.

components.name: Uncanny Dodge
components.description: Halve damage from an attack that hits you when you can see the attacker.

components.text: On a Dexterity save normally dealing half damage on success, take no damage on success and half on failure.
Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) when moving no more than half your speed on the turn.
Treat a d20 result of 9 or lower as 10 on an ability check that adds your proficiency bonus.
Ignore class, race, and level requirements on the use of magic items.
When able to hear, know the location of hidden or invisible creatures within 10 feet.
Take a second turn at initiative minus 10 during the first round of combat, unless surprised.
No attack roll has advantage against you while you are not incapacitated.

components.name: Stroke of Luck
components.description: Turn a miss against a target within range into a hit, or treat the d20 of a failed ability check as 20.
